options.B: Marginalized families often harbor deep-seated mistrust of formal health institutions
options.C: It legally exempts the family from paying any future hospital bills
options.D: Patients will otherwise refuse to answer questions about their financial status

explanation: Vulnerable populations frequently experience stigma or neglect from official systems, making rapport-building essential for accurate data collection. [learn more](GNS225_U5_T19#GNS225_U5_T19_h5)

question: What is an important instruction to provide a patient who is beginning to reintroduce regular foods after a soft diet?

options.A: Avoid chewing food thoroughly to exercise the jaw.
options.B: Reintroduce harder foods slowly and monitor for discomfort.
options.C: Consume all foods rapidly to test digestive strength.
options.D: Eliminate all fluids from the meal plan permanently.

explanation: Gradual reintroduction allows the patient to identify any lingering intolerance, pain, or swallowing difficulty before resuming a normal diet. [learn more](GNS227_U6_T002#GNS227_U6_T002_h7)

question: How does the maternal kidney compensate for the chronic respiratory alkalosis induced by pregnancy-related hyperventilation?

options.A: By excreting increased amounts of bicarbonate in the urine
options.B: By suppressing the production of endogenous aldosterone
options.C: By halting tubular secretion of metabolic organic acids
options.D: By retaining excess hydrogen ions in the extracellular fluid

explanation: To balance the respiratory alkalosis caused by progesterone-driven hyperventilation, the kidneys excrete bicarbonate to keep blood pH within a normal physiological range. [learn more](GNS121_U7_T5#GNS121_U7_T5_h3)

question: Which of the following factors causes a direct decrease in disease prevalence?

options.A: Immigration of affected individuals into the community
options.B: Longer duration of the chronic illness
options.C: An increase in new case diagnoses
options.D: High rate of mortality from the disease

explanation: When a disease causes rapid death, patients exit the pool of existing cases quickly, lowering the calculated prevalence. [learn more](GNS313_U1_T12#GNS313_U1_T12_h4)

question: Which standard prophylactic supplements are routinely given to pregnant women during antenatal care in Nigeria to support haematological adaptation?

options.A: Vitamin C and thiamine
options.B: Iron and folic acid
options.C: Calcium and vitamin D
options.D: Zinc and magnesium

explanation: Routine antenatal care incorporates iron and folic acid supplementation to prevent nutritional deficiencies and support red blood cell expansion. [learn more](GNS121_U7_T1#GNS121_U7_T1_h7)
